title: Vacuum Runtime Log Runtime Minutes Leaderboard
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vacuum:runtime runtime_minutes=*
| stats sum(runtime_minutes) as total_value, avg(runtime_minutes) as avg_value by device_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average runtime minutes across vacuum runtime log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `runtime_minutes` values for each vacuum runtime log event and review total and average runtime minutes by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total runtime minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which device shows the biggest runtime minutes numbers in your vacuum runtime log data.
